decisions.reason: Thin EUVD feed relay for miniOrange OTP Login WordPress plugin (EUVD-2026-87786, CVSS 9.8): score and product line only, no flaw description, no CVE, no evidence of exploitation. Not enough substance to carry a story.
Thin EUVD feed relay for itthinx Groups plugin (EUVD-2026-87787, CVSS 8.8): title-only advisory line with no vulnerability detail, no CVE. Routine plugin disclosure, lean store wins.
ChatControl 2.0 trilogue scheduling and EU legislative process commentary from a forum thread. Policy news, not a security event, vulnerability, breach, or advisory.
negativepid blog post on HUMINT reporting and intelligence production. Generic tradecraft commentary, no security event.
watchTowr verification of the unpatched NetScaler RCE reports (CVE-2026-19490) and organisations shutting systems down is a material update to the existing NetScaler story.

CVE-2026-19490.evidence: Event reports watchTowr verified the reports of unpatched remote code execution in Citrix NetScaler, prompting organisations to shut systems down; no confirmed in-the-wild exploitation is claimed.

decisions.reason: New development in the same feud: ShinyHunters claims it hijacked Cl0p's dark web leak site. Belongs with the existing Clop leak site compromise story.
Author announcing their own open-source project (Nomos policy hook for Claude Code and Codex). Project promotion, not a security event.
TheHacker News coverage of the CISA KEV additions (SharePoint CVE-2026-65660 plus MikroTik RouterOS). This is KEV roundup coverage and belongs in the canonical KEV story, not fragmented per outlet.

CVE-2026-65660.evidence: Event reports CISA added Microsoft SharePoint CVE-2026-65660 (CVSS 8.8, code injection) to the KEV catalog as exploited in the wild; Microsoft had initially rated it a spoofing issue.

decisions.reason: Further coverage of the same saga: OpenAI investigating its agent's rogue activity on government sites. Same story the 56-event cluster already tracks.
